summary: Play-tested both pages (English and Arabic) at 320, 390 and 1440px with Playwright: sections, fonts, menu, touch targets, contrast, images, placeholders and CTA. Everything checked passed except criterion 8: no screenshots are committed on the branch (.releasehub-context is git-excluded) and the PR body could not be read (no gh token). Lighthouse, axe and html-validate were not re-run.

criteria.criterion: 1) Both pages show every section with complete content, no lorem ipsum or empty sections, demo content in one data file and marked demo.
criteria.how: Read innerText length of the 8 section ids on both pages (all 160-944 chars), searched for 'lorem' (none), looked at 390 and 1440 screenshots in EN and AR; content/demo.json exists.

criteria.criterion: 2) Tailwind v4 built CSS with palette tokens; no in-browser Tailwind script.
criteria.how: Pages load assets/css/styles.css only; no console errors or failed requests; no CDN script in the head (grep of the page head).
criteria.note: Token values were not compared hex by hex.

criteria.criterion: 3) Arabic uses IBM Plex Sans Arabic with IBM Plex Sans for Latin, text about 10% larger, no letter-spacing or uppercase.
criteria.how: getComputedStyle on /ar/ and /: h1 font-family starts with IBM Plex Sans Arabic (EN: IBM Plex Sans); paragraph 15.4px vs 14px (1.1x), line-height 26.18px (1.7), letter-spacing normal, text-transform none.

criteria.criterion: 4) At 320, 390 and 1440px in both languages: no horizontal scroll, mirrors in Arabic, phone menu opens and closes by keyboard and tap, targets at least 44px with focus ring, AA contrast.
criteria.how: scrollWidth equals viewport at all 3 widths in both languages; Arabic has dir=rtl; menu opens with Enter and tap, focus stays in the sheet over 12 Tabs, Escape closes it and focus returns to the button (EN and AR, 390px); every a/button/summary is at least 44x44 except the hidden 1x1 skip link; a scan of all visible text at 1440px (EN) found no pair under AA (the step numbers are fixed now); no console warnings and no 404 (favicon is inline).
criteria.note: Contrast scan was run on the English page only; the focus ring was not re-walked in this run.

criteria.criterion: 5) Photos are free-licence Unsplash with descriptive alt text and credits in the footer; no broken images.
criteria.how: After scrolling, all 3 images loaded (naturalWidth 960-1280) at 1440px; each has alt text; the footer lists 3 credit links to Unsplash.
criteria.note: Credits say '[PLACEHOLDER] photographer' (names not known) and the unsplash.com/photos links were not opened to confirm they resolve. The alt 'Office corridor' is short.

criteria.criterion: 6) Prices, CTA address and unconfirmed claims are visibly marked as placeholders and CTA buttons keep data-cta.
criteria.how: 13 placeholder marks on each page (PLACEHOLDER / نص تجريبي); 9 [data-cta] links on each page, all with href '#' (CTA_HREF placeholder).

criteria.criterion: 7) Lighthouse 90+ on mobile and desktop, axe no serious/critical issues, html-validate no errors.
criteria.note: Lighthouse, axe and html-validate need separate tooling that was not set up here; the work run reports its own numbers in the PR.

criteria.criterion: 8) PR lists at least three critique rounds with scores, final scores 4+, and screenshots saved under .releasehub-context/screenshots/ for 390 and 1440px in each language.
criteria.how: git ls-files shows no files under .releasehub-context/ and no en-390/en-1440/ar-390/ar-1440 images on the branch; .releasehub-context/ is in .git/info/exclude. gh could not read the PR body (no token).
criteria.note: The screenshots are not committed (same finding as the earlier rounds), and the PR rounds could not be verified.

criteria.criterion: 9) The template used is credited in the README and CLAUDE.local.md has a block headed with this story's title.
criteria.how: CLAUDE.local.md has the block 'Redesign the whole landing page to a professional standard (RHL-10)'; the README credit was not opened in this run.
criteria.note: task.md says no template was downloaded, only shadcn/ui and HyperUI patterns are credited as inspiration.
